```{r}
iso3_results<-read_csv(here("output_data/Paolo_results/Collated/Final_country_all_results.csv")) %>% 
  filter(!rgn_key %in% c("CAN", "RUS", "POL", "CHL"))

global_results<-read_csv(here("output_data/Paolo_results/Collated/Global_all_results.csv"))
```
# Siting decision figure

```{r}
siting_dat<-iso3_results %>% 
  select(rgn_key, prop_wind_int, buff, iso3_wind_km2, total_wind, overlap_wind, type, prop_count) %>% 
  filter(buff == 1)

siting_global_dat<-global_results %>% 
  select(buff, prop_int_wind, bio_eez_wind_km2, total_count, overlap_wind, type) %>% 
  mutate(prop_count = overlap_wind/total_count,
         type = ifelse(type == "Non strict MPA", "Non-strict MPA", type)) %>% 
  rename(prop_wind_int = prop_int_wind,
         iso3_wind_km2 = bio_eez_wind_km2,
         total_wind = total_count) %>% 
  mutate(rgn_key = "World") %>% 
  filter(buff == 1)

all_siting<-rbind(siting_global_dat, siting_dat) %>% 
  mutate(name = countrycode(sourcevar = rgn_key, origin = "iso3c", destination = "country.name.en")) %>% 
  mutate(name = ifelse(is.na(name) == T, "World", name)) %>% 
  select(-buff)
```
```{r}
wide_supp <- all_siting %>%
  select(iso3 = rgn_key,
    country = name,
    total_wind,
    prop_wind_int,
    type,
    n_overlap = overlap_wind,
    area_km2 = iso3_wind_km2,
    pct_overlap = prop_count
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_overlap = 100 * pct_overlap
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(iso3, country, total_wind, prop_wind_int),
    names_from = type,
    values_from = c(n_overlap, area_km2, pct_overlap),
    names_glue = "{type}_{.value}",
    values_fill = list(n_overlap = 0, area_km2 = 0, pct_overlap = 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(country)


```

```{r}
write.csv(wide_supp, here("output_data/Supp_table_siting_overlap.csv"))
```

```{r}
all_siting2<-all_siting %>% 
  filter(!is.na(prop_count),
         prop_count>0)

all_siting2 <- all_siting2 %>%
  mutate(
    overlap_wind_cat = cut(
      overlap_wind,
      breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, Inf),
      labels = c(
        "1",
        "2",
        "3–4",
        "5–9",
        "10–49",
        "50–99",
        "100–249",
        "250–499",
        "500–999",
        "1000–1999",
        "≥2000"
      ),
      right = TRUE,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  )

```


```{r}
all_siting3<-all_siting2 %>% 
  filter(!rgn_key == "World")
 
```

```{r}

ggplot(all_siting3, aes(
  x = overlap_wind,
  y = prop_count * 100,
  fill = total_wind/1000
)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = rgn_key), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    y = "Percent of turbines overlapping feature",
    x = "Number of turbines overlapping feature",
    fill = "Total turbines\n(thousands)"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
df_grad <- all_siting2 %>%
  mutate(
    # order countries within each feature by overlap (low -> high)
    country_ord = tidytext::reorder_within(rgn_key, prop_count, type)
  ) %>% 
  filter(!name == "World")

ggplot(df_grad, aes(x = prop_count*100, y = type)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = overlap_wind, colour = total_wind), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = name), hjust = -0.2, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Turbines overlapping\nfeature (#)",
    range = c(2, 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Turbines overlapping feature (%)",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Total turbines (#)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
   # panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
```{r}
ggsave(here("figures/Number_turbine_overlap_gradient_plot.png"), width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 600)
```

```{r}
df_bar <- all_siting2 %>%
  filter(name != "World") %>%
  mutate(country_ord = reorder_within(name, prop_count, type))

ggplot(df_bar, aes(x = prop_count * 100, y = country_ord, fill = total_wind/1000)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = comma(overlap_wind)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3) +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,100)) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1, name = "Total turbines\n(thousands)") +
  labs(x = "Turbines overlapping feature (%)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.8, "lines")
  )
```

ggsave(here("figures/Turbine_overlap_barchart.png"), width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 600)
